Programs and tools built with our community. Each one works toward the same goal:
keeping the genetics, knowledge, and practices that sustain vulnerable plants in the
hands of the people who care for them.

## The Regenerative Relations Initiative {#regenerative-relations-initiative}

Indigenous Traditional Ecological and Cultural Knowledge (ITECK) systems have sustained species-rich ecosystems for millennia through intentional stewardship and deep, place-based relationships. Through the Regenerative Relations Initiative (RRI), Copyleft Cultivars offers our community, our collective resources and tools to support the continuance of ITECK systems that communities have stewarded since time immemorial.

### Community Data Governance

A critical element of RRI’s vision and work is uplifting and protecting a community’s right to govern their data.

### Protecting Community Knowledge

We believe it is important for communities to inform and define how their ecological and traditional knowledge is collected, stored, shared, and protected in open-source and copyleft frameworks.

### Community-Defined Protocols & Protections

This work is only possible with relationship building:

- Community leadership sets the direction of project engagement, and support is shaped around each territory’s own priorities and protocols.
- Reciprocal relationships with land, water, and plant relatives guide our work.
- Communities retain full authority over their own knowledge and data.

### Conservation & Land Stewardship

We stand with communities caring for their lands and waters in the face of unregulated extraction and monoculture expansion. The support we will offer to partnering communities in land restoration and conservation will be customized to each community’s ecological context, connecting them with relevant expertise and resources.

### Building Relationships

We are in early relationship-building with communities in Turtle Island and Abya Yala. Our long-term hope is to cultivate a genuine peer network where land-based communities exchange strategies and support directly. This is an early, unrealized idea that we intend to grow toward together. We do not yet have a cohort, fixed timeline, or set schedule of meetings. RRI partnerships are still taking shape, initially as a direct relationship between a community and ours.

#### Direct Site Visits

Our Director of Indigenous Relations and Collaborative Research has personally traveled to visit communities, begin building relationships, and gain a firsthand understanding of their context.

This work is currently self-funded while grant support is pursued.

### Get in touch

Communities and organizations interested in building a relationship with us can reach the RRI team at [copyleftcultivars@gmail.com](mailto:copyleftcultivars@gmail.com).

## Natural Farming Fertilizer Assistant Chatbot

Conventional farming is hard, expensive, and hurts the environment. Getting help
for sustainable practices is costly and slow. Copyleft Cultivars offers on-demand AI
assistants for regenerative farming through web apps and voice interfaces. Our beta
has over 700 testers and over 100 supporting users across 8 countries and 40 farms,
helping both small farms and large productions. Users have interacted with our
chatbot in more than 100 languages. We are prototyping new AI assistants which work
even without internet access and in various languages, with agronomic precision.

Copyleft Cultivars' Natural Farming Fertilizer Assistant Chatbot aims to create
customized, localized, free Natural Farming fertilizer recipes, most of which can be
made with local free ingredients.

[Access Our Agriculture Assistant](https://huggingface.co/spaces/CopyleftCultivars/natural-farming-chat-V4){.btn .btn-primary role="button" target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
